news:
Welcome to the Renown Realm!

NEW on the Barrens Front (1-19):
- Influence: fill the bar on the front and claim rewards from the Rally Master - tier 3 is a unique faction tabard
- Domination bar: objectives, kills, battlegrounds and war boards push the front toward a siege
- Lane captures: your tower, the Oasis, then theirs
- New war boards with quest markers

Also: WoW Forever Warrior talents, loot bags from PvP kills with bonus enchants, Frontline level 60 greens, 15 minute Warsong Gulch.

Click the banner button in game for the PvP panel.
